stem: Which assignment correctly describes fuzzification, rule inference and defuzzification in fuzzy control?

options.text: Fuzzification maps inputs to grades; rules infer output activation; defuzzification produces a crisp command.
Fuzzification produces a crisp command; rules infer output activation; defuzzification maps inputs to grades.

Fuzzification chooses output rules; rules map measurements to input grades; defuzzification produces a crisp command.
